senses.gloss:
लयः [ली-अच्]
—1 Sticking, union, adherence.
—2 Lurking, hiding.
—3 Fusion, melting, solution.
—4 Disappearance, dissolution, extinction, destruction; universal destruction
 (प्रलय); लयं या ‘to be dissolved or destroyed’.
—5 Absorption of the mind, deep concentration, exclusive devotion (to
 any one object); पश्यन्ती शिवरूपिणं लयवशादात्मानमभ्यागता Māl. 5. 2, 7;
 ध्यानलयेन Gīt. 4.
—6 Time in music (of three kinds━ द्रुत, मध्य, and विलम्बित);
 किसलयैः सलयैरिव पाणिभिः R. 9. 35; पादन्यासो लयमनुगतः
 M. 2. 9; मध्यलम्बितपरिच्छिन्नस्त्रिधायं लयः Nāg. 1. 14.
—7 A pause in music.
—8 Rest, repose.
—9 A place of rest, abode, habitation; अलया Śi. 4. 57 ‘having no fixed abode, wandering’
.
—10 Slackness of mind, mental inactivity; (also used in adjectival sense;
 यदा जयेद्रजः सत्त्वं तमो मूढं लयं जडम् Bhāg. 11. 25. 15.).
—11 An embrace.
—12 The Supreme Being.
—13 The union of song, dance, and instrumental music; गायतं मधुरं
 गेयं तन्त्रीलयसमन्वितम् Rām. 7. 93. 15.
—14 A swoon.
—15 The quick (downward) movement of an arrow.
.━{@Comp.@}: लयार्कः, लयारम्भः, लयालम्भः, लयकालः, लयगत, लयनालिकः, लयपुत्री, लयमध्य, लयशुद्ध, लयस्थानम्
लयः + -अर्कः the sun at the destruction of the universe.
लयः + -कालः the time of destruction (of the world.).
लयः + -नालिकः a Buddhist or Jain temple.
लयः + -पुत्री an actress, a female dancer.
लयः + -मध्य a. to be performed in moderate time (a piece of music).
लयः + -शुद्ध a. to be performed in right time.

लयनम् [ली-ल्युट्]
—1 Adhering, clinging, sticking.
—2 Rest, repose.
—3 A place of rest, house.
